title: The difference between rivers
prompt:
Two channels carry the same river in opposite phases around a shared current.
Subtract right from left in signed 16-bit PCM. Absolute differences above 1000 are ON, below 1000 are OFF.
One unit is 240 samples at 8000 Hz. Standard International Morse: mark 1/3 units, within-letter gap 1, between-letter gap 3.
There are no word gaps. Decode lowercase ASCII letters.
The first 64 right-channel sample low bits also speak, MSB-first, without a header. Their door is recorded beside the wave.
